quote: For generation tasks, the server recursively generates a sequence of token indices, which can only be decoded by the client using the shuffled vocabulary. This approach ensures privacy while preserving the utility of the model for both tasks.
For generation tasks, we use the Llama3-8b model (AI@Meta, 2024), and choose Alpaca (cleaned) and Databricks-dolly-15k datasets. We evaluate the two datasets with RougeL and Rouge1.
ObfusLM provides robust protection for clients' input texts as well as the generated outputs produced by the model.
